input.sql:
WITH prod AS (
  SELECT ORIG_RM_ID AS RM_ID, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) AS NEW_COMMIT
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY
  WHERE ORIG_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.REGION, r.TEAM, COUNT(DISTINCT r.RM_ID) AS RMS,
       SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL) AS GOAL_Q3,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0)) AS BOOKED_Q3,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL),0),3) AS ATTAIN_Q3,
       SUM(IFF(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0) >= g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL,1,0)) AS RMS_AT_GOAL
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL g
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
WHERE g.FQTR='2026Q3'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH ex AS (
  SELECT CIF_NO, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) AS COMMIT_AMT
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY WHERE FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1),
lc AS (
  SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.RM_ID FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c JOIN ex ON ex.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO
  WHERE c.SEGMENT_CD='LC' AND c.CLIENT_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND ex.COMMIT_AMT > 25000000),
lastc AS (
  SELECT CIF_NO, MAX(CONTACT_DT) AS LAST_DT FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT
  WHERE CONTACT_DT <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
q3c AS (
  SELECT r.TEAM, COUNT(*) AS RM_CONTACTS_Q3
  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT k JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=k.BANKER_ID
  WHERE k.BANKER_ROLE='RM' AND k.CONTACT_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
cov AS (
  SELECT r.TEAM, COUNT(*) AS LC_IN_SCOPE,
         SUM(IFF(l.LAST_DT IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(day,l.LAST_DT,'2026-09-30'::date) > 90,1,0)) AS LC_OVERDUE
  FROM lc JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=lc.RM_ID
  LEFT JOIN lastc l ON l.CIF_NO=lc.CIF_NO GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.TEAM, q.RM_CONTACTS_Q3, c.LC_IN_SCOPE, c.LC_OVERDUE
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TEAM FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER) r
LEFT JOIN q3c q ON q.TEAM=r.TEAM LEFT JOIN cov c ON c.TEAM=r.TEAM ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.TEAM,
       SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS DRAWN,
       SUM(IFF(b.DPD>=30,b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS DPD30_BAL,
       SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N',b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS NONACCRUAL_BAL,
       SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N' OR (b.DPD>=90 AND b.ACCRUAL_STAT='A'),b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS NPL_BAL,
       ROUND(SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N' OR (b.DPD>=90 AND b.ACCRUAL_STAT='A'),b.DRAWN_AMT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT),0),4) AS NPL_RATIO,
       SUM(IFF(f.RISK_RATING>=7,f.COMMIT_AMT,0)) AS CRITICIZED_COMMIT
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=c.RM_ID
WHERE f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH prod AS (
  SELECT ORIG_RM_ID AS RM_ID, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) AS NEW_COMMIT
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY
  WHERE ORIG_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.REGION, r.TEAM, COUNT(DISTINCT r.RM_ID) AS RMS,
       SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL) AS GOAL_Q3,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0)) AS BOOKED_Q3,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL),0),3) AS ATTAIN_Q3,
       SUM(IFF(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0) >= g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL,1,0)) AS RMS_AT_GOAL
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL g
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
WHERE g.FQTR='2026Q3'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

reasoning: I'm confirming that risk rating 7 corresponds to Special Mention, so "criticized" loans means rated Special Mention or worse, consistent with how I've answered before. I also note RM_CONTACTS_Q3 should be counted based on contacts logged by RMs on that banker team.
text:
I can't give you suspicious-activity (SAR) case counts by relationship-manager team. Under the Bank Secrecy Act, even the fact that a SAR exists is confidential. Bank policy POL-BSA-01 lets only the BSA/AML function use the case table (`BANK_DEMO.FINCRIME.SAR_CASE`), and says SAR data may never be used for coaching, performance reviews, rankings or incentive pay. A team-level count would still show that SARs exist, and it could discourage bankers from escalating suspicious activity. I didn't query that table. If you need financial-crimes training for a team, ask the BSA Officer, who sets it.

Instead, here is a coaching view built only from approved measures, for Q3 2026 (July 1 to September 30, 2026):

| Region | Team | RMs | Q3 goal | Booked | Goal reached | RMs at goal | RM contacts in Q3 | Large Corporate clients overdue for contact | Past due 30+ days (drawn) | Rated 7 or worse (commitments) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Central | Business Banking | 7 | $165.8M | $135.8M | 81.9% | 2 | 508 | – | $5.0M | $82.4M |
| Central | C&I Central | 5 | $81.0M | $93.6M | 115.6% | 5 | 351 | 2 of 14 | $1.6M | $160.3M |
| Central | MM Central | 4 | $91.5M | $83.1M | 90.8% | 1 | 186 | – | $7.1M | $265.6M |
| East | C&I East | 6 | $525.2M | $406.6M | **77.4%** | 2 | 249 | **9 of 23** | $7.0M | $51.2M |
| East | CRE Banking | 6 | $163.1M | $155.4M | 95.3% | 3 | 238 | – | **$432.0M** | **$842.4M** |
| East | MM East | 4 | $53.7M | $52.5M | 97.8% | 2 | 155 | – | $4.8M | $196.8M |
| East | Public Sector | 6 | $142.2M | $114.5M | 80.5% | **0** | 150 | – | $0.3M | $385.3M |
| Southeast | MM Southeast | 7 | $104.7M | $113.4M | 108.3% | 6 | 104 | – | $1.7M | $230.3M |
| West | C&I West | 6 | $135.4M | $137.2M | 101.3% | 3 | 226 | 1 of 1 | $22.1M | $42.0M |
| West | MM West | 6 | $131.4M | $125.2M | 95.3% | 3 | 113 | – | $21.9M | $235.2M |

"Overdue for contact" means no banker contact in the last 90 days, under standard BR-COVER-01. A dash means the team has no clients that the standard covers. The last two columns are as of September 30, 2026.

**Where coaching could focus:**
- **C&I East:** it has the lowest share of goal reached (77.4%) on the biggest goal ($525M). It also has 9 of its 23 Large Corporate clients overdue for contact, so it falls short on both production and coverage.
- **Public Sector Banking:** none of its 6 RMs reached their Q3 goal, and the team reached 80.5% overall.
- **Business Banking:** 81.9% of goal, with only 2 of 7 RMs at goal.
- **CRE Banking:** its book needs the most credit-quality attention. It has $432M past due 30 days or more and $113.9M on non-accrual, a non-performing loan ratio of 1.84%. It also has $842M of commitments rated 7 or worse. Every other team has no non-performing loans.
- **C&I West:** its one Large Corporate client in scope is overdue for contact. It and MM West each also have about $22M past due 30 days or more.
- **Strongest teams:** C&I Central (all 5 RMs at goal) and MM Southeast (6 of 7 at goal).

I can break any team down to individual RMs if that helps.

**Sources and assumptions**
- **Policy:** the knowledge layer's policy check flagged POL-BSA-01 (31 CFR 1020.320(e); BSA/AML Policy FC-04) for this role and purpose. The data product that holds this table (Financial Crimes) is restricted. Tax IDs in the table are also always masked under POL-PII-02. A similar past answer (ranking RMs by SAR counts) was refused for the same reason and offered the same alternative.
- **Goal reached:** the bank's ratified `new_commit_attainment` measure. It divides commitments booked in Q3 and credited to the RM who originated them by that RM's Q3 2026 goal (tables `LENDING.FACILITY` and `CORE.RM_GOAL`).
- **Contact coverage:** follows BR-COVER-01. It covers active Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments, uses the latest contact by any banker (including treasury-management officers), and assigns clients to their main RM's team. The "RM contacts in Q3" column counts only contacts logged by RMs on each team.
- **Credit quality:** taken from each facility's September 30, 2026 balance (`LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`), active facilities only, assigned to the client's main RM's team.
  - Non-performing loans are non-accrual balances plus loans 90+ days past due that are still accruing, which follows the definition of the ratified `npl_ratio` measure. I calculated it from facility balances rather than the product-level reporting table.
  - Internal rating 7 is Special Mention, so the last column covers Special Mention or worse.
- **Team assignment:** team and region come from `CORE.RM_ROSTER`.

cypher.cypher:
CREATE (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id, question: $question, answer: $answer, role: $role, agent: $agent,
                                  ts: datetime($ts), description: $question, embedding: $vec})

WITH prod AS (
  SELECT ORIG_RM_ID AS RM_ID, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) AS NEW_COMMIT
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY
  WHERE ORIG_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.REGION, r.TEAM, COUNT(DISTINCT r.RM_ID) AS RMS,
       SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL) AS GOAL_Q3,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0)) AS BOOKED_Q3,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL),0),3) AS ATTAIN_Q3,
       SUM(IFF(COALESCE(p.NEW_COMMIT,0) >= g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL,1,0)) AS RMS_AT_GOAL
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL g
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.RM_ID=g.RM_ID
WHERE g.FQTR='2026Q3'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH ex AS (
  SELECT CIF_NO, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) AS COMMIT_AMT
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY WHERE FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1),
lc AS (
  SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.RM_ID FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c JOIN ex ON ex.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO
  WHERE c.SEGMENT_CD='LC' AND c.CLIENT_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND ex.COMMIT_AMT > 25000000),
lastc AS (
  SELECT CIF_NO, MAX(CONTACT_DT) AS LAST_DT FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT
  WHERE CONTACT_DT <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
q3c AS (
  SELECT r.TEAM, COUNT(*) AS RM_CONTACTS_Q3
  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT k JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=k.BANKER_ID
  WHERE k.BANKER_ROLE='RM' AND k.CONTACT_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
cov AS (
  SELECT r.TEAM, COUNT(*) AS LC_IN_SCOPE,
         SUM(IFF(l.LAST_DT IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(day,l.LAST_DT,'2026-09-30'::date) > 90,1,0)) AS LC_OVERDUE
  FROM lc JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=lc.RM_ID
  LEFT JOIN lastc l ON l.CIF_NO=lc.CIF_NO GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.TEAM, q.RM_CONTACTS_Q3, c.LC_IN_SCOPE, c.LC_OVERDUE
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TEAM FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER) r
LEFT JOIN q3c q ON q.TEAM=r.TEAM LEFT JOIN cov c ON c.TEAM=r.TEAM ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.TEAM,
       SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS DRAWN,
       SUM(IFF(b.DPD>=30,b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS DPD30_BAL,
       SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N',b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS NONACCRUAL_BAL,
       SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N' OR (b.DPD>=90 AND b.ACCRUAL_STAT='A'),b.DRAWN_AMT,0)) AS NPL_BAL,
       ROUND(SUM(IFF(b.ACCRUAL_STAT='N' OR (b.DPD>=90 AND b.ACCRUAL_STAT='A'),b.DRAWN_AMT,0))/NULLIF(SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT),0),4) AS NPL_RATIO,
       SUM(IFF(f.RISK_RATING>=7,f.COMMIT_AMT,0)) AS CRITICIZED_COMMIT
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO=f.CIF_NO
JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=c.RM_ID
WHERE f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $names AS nm
                  CALL (nm) {
                    MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Concept OR n:DataProduct OR n:Metric OR n:JoinPath OR n:Policy OR n:Report OR n:BusinessRule)
                      AND (toLower(n.name) = toLower(nm) OR n.id = nm OR toLower(n.id) = toLower(nm))
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1
                    UNION
                    MATCH (n:Table) WHERE toUpper(n.fq_name) = toUpper(nm) OR toUpper(n.fq_name) ENDS WITH '.' + toUpper(nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1 }
                  MERGE (d)-[:USED]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT coalesce(n.fq_name, n.name, n.id)) AS linked

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $ids AS eid
                 MATCH (n:LegalEntity) WHERE n.id = eid
                 MERGE (d)-[:ABOUT]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT n.id) AS about

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $checks AS c
                   MATCH (p:Policy {id: c.policy})
                   MERGE (d)-[r:CHECKED]->(p) SET r.decision = c.decision RETURN collect(p.id + ':' + c.decision) AS checked

question: Show suspicious-activity case counts by relationship-manager team over the last quarter so regional managers can plan RM coaching.
answer:
I can't give you suspicious-activity (SAR) case counts by relationship-manager team. Under the Bank Secrecy Act, even the fact that a SAR exists is confidential. Bank policy POL-BSA-01 lets only the BSA/AML function use the case table (`BANK_DEMO.FINCRIME.SAR_CASE`), and says SAR data may never be used for coaching, performance reviews, rankings or incentive pay. A team-level count would still show that SARs exist, and it could discourage bankers from escalating suspicious activity. I didn't query that table. If you need financial-crimes training for a team, ask the BSA Officer, who sets it.

Instead, here is a coaching view built only from approved measures, for Q3 2026 (July 1 to September 30, 2026):

| Region | Team | RMs | Q3 goal | Booked | Goal reached | RMs at goal | RM contacts in Q3 | Large Corporate clients overdue for contact | Past due 30+ days (drawn) | Rated 7 or worse (commitments) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Central | Business Banking | 7 | $165.8M | $135.8M | 81.9% | 2 | 508 | – | $5.0M | $82.4M |
| Central | C&I Central | 5 | $81.0M | $93.6M | 115.6% | 5 | 351 | 2 of 14 | $1.6M | $160.3M |
| Central | MM Central | 4 | $91.5M | $83.1M | 90.8% | 1 | 186 | – | $7.1M | $265.6M |
| East | C&I East | 6 | $525.2M | $406.6M | **77.4%** | 2 | 249 | **9 of 23** | $7.0M | $51.2M |
| East | CRE Banking | 6 | $163.1M | $155.4M | 95.3% | 3 | 238 | – | **$432.0M** | **$842.4M** |
| East | MM East | 4 | $53.7M | $52.5M | 97.8% | 2 | 155 | – | $4.8M | $196.8M |
| East | Public Sector | 6 | $142.2M | $114.5M | 80.5% | **0** | 150 | – | $0.3M | $385.3M |
| Southeast | MM Southeast | 7 | $104.7M | $113.4M | 108.3% | 6 | 104 | – | $1.7M | $230.3M |
| West | C&I West | 6 | $135.4M | $137.2M | 101.3% | 3 | 226 | 1 of 1 | $22.1M | $42.0M |
| West | MM West | 6 | $131.4M | $125.2M | 95.3% | 3 | 113 | – | $21.9M | $235.2M |

"Overdue for contact" means no banker contact in the last 90 days, under standard BR-COVER-01. A dash means the team has no clients that the standard covers. The last two columns are as of September 30, 2026.

**Where coaching could focus:**
- **C&I East:** it has the lowest share of goal reached (77.4%) on the biggest goal ($525M). It also has 9 of its 23 Large Corporate clients overdue for contact, so it falls short on both production and coverage.
- **Public Sector Banking:** none of its 6 RMs reached their Q3 goal, and the team reached 80.5% overall.
- **Business Banking:** 81.9% of goal, with only 2 of 7 RMs at goal.
- **CRE Banking:** its book needs the most credit-quality attention. It has $432M past due 30 days or more and $113.9M on non-accrual, a non-performing loan ratio of 1.84%. It also has $842M of commitments rated 7 or worse. Every other team has no non-performing loans.
- **C&I West:** its one Large Corporate client in scope is overdue for contact. It and MM West each also have about $22M past due 30 days or more.
- **Strongest teams:** C&I Central (all 5 RMs at goal) and MM Southeast (6 of 7 at goal).

I can break any team down to individual RMs if that helps.

**Sources and assumptions**
- **Policy:** the knowledge layer's policy check flagged POL-BSA-01 (31 CFR 1020.320(e); BSA/AML Policy FC-04) for this role and purpose. The data product that holds this table (Financial Crimes) is restricted. Tax IDs in the table are also always masked under POL-PII-02. A similar past answer (ranking RMs by SAR counts) was refused for the same reason and offered the same alternative.
- **Goal reached:** the bank's ratified `new_commit_attainment` measure. It divides commitments booked in Q3 and credited to the RM who originated them by that RM's Q3 2026 goal (tables `LENDING.FACILITY` and `CORE.RM_GOAL`).
- **Contact coverage:** follows BR-COVER-01. It covers active Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments, uses the latest contact by any banker (including treasury-management officers), and assigns clients to their main RM's team. The "RM contacts in Q3" column counts only contacts logged by RMs on each team.
- **Credit quality:** taken from each facility's September 30, 2026 balance (`LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`), active facilities only, assigned to the client's main RM's team.
  - Non-performing loans are non-accrual balances plus loans 90+ days past due that are still accruing, which follows the definition of the ratified `npl_ratio` measure. I calculated it from facility balances rather than the product-level reporting table.
  - Internal rating 7 is Special Mention, so the last column covers Special Mention or worse.
- **Team assignment:** team and region come from `CORE.RM_ROSTER`.
